title: Unit orientations of n-planes are nonzero n-vectors of operator norm at most one
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, i.e. a continuous linear functional on the normed space Λ^n(ℝ^P) = Covector (Euclid P) n of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P (with Mathlib's operator norm). Let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P. Suppose ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q): there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P spanning Q such that either ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every α. Then ξ ≠ 0 and ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 (operator norm on (Λ^n)*).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ξ ≠ 0 ∧ ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
